audit.why: 47.74% over 1106 games: LeBlanc owns levels 1-6 with Sigil-Distortion burst-and-escape, Qiyana flips it at first item. Content layer frames this correctly; full layer's level chart did not (see point 3).

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer level chart was blanket 'Skill' on all seven rows with generic template whys, while content win[] and the packet both give LeBlanc levels 1-6 and Qiyana from first item on.
audit.why: Content and packet agree; the full-layer whys named no LeBlanc mechanic at all.
audit.corrected: Sides moved to match win[] (already correct, so no content edits), whys rewritten around Sigil, Distortion's return window and Mimic, ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers. Distortion is 15s at rank 1 (10s max) with a 4s return window; Ethereal Chains 14s; Mimic 45/35/25s.
audit.why: The punish window after she burns W is the whole matchup and deserves real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ten misgendered fields (LeBlanc called he/his/him) and two copy-paste bleeds (dosFull[1].d = tradeGood, dontsFull[2].d = tradeBad).

edits.before: - LeBlanc Distortion: matchup-defining — Dash with a four-second return window — punish the return spot, and remember she is broke after it. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Terrashape (element swap) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
